description: Ask a question about America’s 100 most famous politicians (best president, who would win a fistfight, who has the best hair). Jev, TypeSafe AI’s decision model, scores all 100 and returns its top pick, the runners-up, and how sure it is. Opinion, not fact. Questions about abuse or private traits are refused; accusations only name people at 90% or higher.
name: ask_jev
title: Ask Jev about US politicians
